stemMd: No clay sample is metallic. Some red samples are clay. Which statement follows?

options.label: B
options.textMd: Some red samples are not metallic.

explanationMd: The red samples that are clay cannot be metallic. This gives an existential conclusion about red samples, not a universal one.

distractorRationale.d: No such converse relation is supplied.
distractorRationale.c: Other red samples may be metallic.
distractorRationale.a: Only some red samples are identified as clay.
